Meet the Kreat Bio client portal. Your microbiome sequencing results, organised in one place and ready to explore. Just enter your access code.
Your report opens with a clear roadmap, guiding you from the big picture to composition, diversity, relationships, and predicted function.
The overall summary shows the dominant microbes, how your groups relate, and how strong the statistical support is, before you dive into the details.
Every step is explained, from your samples and sequencing reads, through quality control, to the final results.
Explore which species are present, with interactive abundance bars for every sample, and download figures straight from the page.
Diversity within and between samples is shown alongside the exact statistical test, so you always know what the data actually supports.
Ordination plots reveal how your samples and groups relate to each other, with the statistics shown right beside them.
Predicted functional pathways are summarised in heatmaps, with careful notes on what predictions can and cannot tell you.
Clear next-step suggestions, a metric guide, and a plain-language glossary help you turn results into decisions.
The Kreat Bio client portal. Your data, made clear. Visit kreat bio dot com slash client portal.
